how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Post Doctoral Researcher Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Post Doctoral Researcher recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Post Doctoral Researcher positions at IIT Madras is 13th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post Doctoral Researcher role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD, preferably in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or Computer Science, to be eligible for the Post Doctoral Researcher positions.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Post Doctoral Researcher post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Post Doctoral Researcher position announced by IIT Madras in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Post Doctoral Researcher position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Post Doctoral Researcher role will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 1,00,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Madras Post Doctoral Researcher recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Post Doctoral Researcher positions?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Post Doctoral Researcher positions at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q7. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Post Doctoral Researcher positions typically involves shortlisting of candidates, followed by a test or interview, and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Madras offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IIT Madras Post Doctoral Researcher recruitment is ICSR/PR/Advt.142/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The official website of Indian Institute of Technology Madras is https://www.iitm.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information and to access the application portal.
